title: Goal-Oriented Bundle Management and Flow Control for Deep-Space Communications via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13923v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep-space communications operate under intermittent connectivity, long propagation delays, and relay storage constraints. In such networks, the Bundle Protocol enables store-carry-forward communication, requiring relay nodes to manage limited storage and scarce contact opportunities. Relay-side scheduling and dropping decisions are inherently goal-oriented: transmission resources should be allocated to bundles most valuable to downstream mission objectives. Conventional schedulers, such as FIFO, do not explicitly optimize task utility and may provide unfair service across heterogeneous planetary sources. This paper presents a closed-loop modeling and learning framework for relay-side bundle and flow management in a contact-driven deep-space network, where lunar and Martian updates are forwarded through a shared-buffer relay to Earth. translated_title: 基于强化学习的面向目标的深空通信捆绑包管理与流量控制
translated_abstract: 深空通信在间歇性连接、长传播时延和中继存储约束的条件下运行。在这类网络中，捆绑包协议支持“存储-携带-转发”的通信方式，要求中继节点管理有限的存储资源和稀缺的接触机会。中继侧的调度与丢弃决策本质上是面向目标的：传输资源应当分配给那些对下游任务目标最有价值的捆绑包。传统调度器（如先进先出FIFO）并不显式地优化任务效用，并且可能在异构的行星数据源之间提供不公平的服务。本文针对接触驱动的深空网络，提出了一种用于中继侧捆绑包与流量管理的闭环建模与学习框架，其中月球和火星的数据更新通过共享缓冲区的中继节点转发至地球。我们使用过剩年龄 Δ_i^e(t)=[Δ_i(t)-d_i(t)…（原文摘要在此处截断）来量化接收端的信息新鲜度。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的闭环框架，用于接触驱动深空网络中继节点的捆绑包调度与丢弃决策，通过优化接收端信息年龄（信息新鲜度）来提升月球与火星数据向地球传输的任务效用与公平性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a closed-loop reinforcement learning framework for relay-side bundle scheduling and dropping in contact-driven deep-space networks, optimizing destination-side information freshness (excess age of information) to improve mission utility and fairness for lunar and Martian data forwarded to Earth.
